note: the whole object is the game sound driver (O.BIN prefix SD_): command queue, VAB bank slots, BGM sequences, sound-effect keys, CD-audio voice clips, CD level meter init. NOT date code (unit label m-dates-a is wrong; see spec)
pushes the low 16 bits of one command word onto the driver queue (tail call to func_8007B5EC); only caller func_80044750 (core: snd_command); O.BIN SD_Call_SD (med, size equal)

same name as core; drains the queue switching on id & 0xF00 (0 control, 2 BGM, 3 voice clip, 5-8 sound effects), then snd_xa_frame_update, snd_pending_update, snd_queue_clear; emu: runs once per frame from the main loop, TT calls it itself; O.BIN SD_Task (med)

takes the lowest slot i with request bit 0x01000000<<i while no running bit 0xF0000000 is set: moves it to running bit 0x10000000<<i, calls snd_vab_transfer(i), clears the running bit (one slot per call); emu: request bits 0x04000000/0x0C000000 then 0x48000000 at frame 1463 after command 0x12; O.BIN SD_HandleVBLVAB (low)

SsVabOpenHeadSticky(header RAM, slot, SPU address) then state bit 0x10000<<slot, SsVabTransBody(body RAM, slot) and SsVabTransCompleted wait; on a -1 result reports (slot<<8)|0x01010000 or 0x01020000 via func_80059B04; emu: state word gains 0x40000 then 0xC0000 for slots 2,3; O.BIN SD_TransVAB (low)

returns 1 when neither request bit nor running bit of the BGM slot (bgm_slot) is set; the argument is never read (asm stores a0 and ignores it), so the callers passing slots 0..3 all test the BGM slot; O.BIN SD_ISVabAvailable (med)
per frame: state 0x400 (voice playing) -> snd_xa_check_end; request 0x200 (start issued) -> snd_xa_start_poll; O.BIN SD_XATask (med)

at or past xa_clip_end (xa_position_get() >= it): snd_xa_fade_start(0xB4) unless a voice fade already runs (otherwise nothing happens); before the end: SD_GetCDLevel(&D_80125E60) refreshes the level meter; O.BIN SD_CheckXASector (med)

once cd_state_get() has bit 4 (XA playing): clear request 0x200; a queued next clip -> stop, promote, start it; else if not paused set state 0x400, clear 0x100000, xa_volume = xa_volume_full, SsSetMVol(0x7F,0x7F), SsSetSerialVol(0,xa_volume), serial mix on; O.BIN SD_IsXAReady (low)
if request_flags != 0: top byte -> snd_vab_transfer_schedule, low byte -> snd_bgm_update, second byte -> snd_xa_fade_update; O.BIN SD_HandleVBL (low)

class 0 commands by id & 0xF0: 0x10 bank transfer, 0x20 bank assignment, 0x70 stop (bit 1 BGM, 2 voices, 4 voice clip), 0xB0/0xC0/0xD0 fade (bit 1 BGM, 4 voice clip), 0xE0 pause, 0xF0 resume (the voice-clip bits 0x74/0xE4/0xF4 call snd_xa_control and then snd_xa_promote_next), anything else snd_cmd_system; emu: 0x7F, 0x12, 0x23/0x24/0x2E, 0x6, 0x71 seen; O.BIN SD_BranchCTRL (med)

ids 0x11 (slots 0,1), 0x12 (slots 2,3), 0x13-0x16 (one slot): snd_vab_body_addr_set, then per slot snd_vab_dispose + snd_vab_request_transfer; emu: command 0x12 at frame 1462 sets request bits 0x04000000 then 0x0C000000; O.BIN SD_VABTransfer (med)

ids 0x21/0x24 set se_slot_a,se_slot_b = 0,3 / 3,0; 0x22/0x23 set bgm_slot,bgm_aux_slot = 1,2 / 2,1; 0x2F/0x2E pick sequence pack set 0/1 (RAM 0x8001C000 / 0x8002E800) and index it; emu dump after 0x23,0x24,0x2E: slots 2,1,3,0 and set 1; O.BIN SD_BufferUpdate (med)

ids 1 mono, 2 stereo (snd_output_mode_set), 3 snd_xa_forget, 4 snd_voices_kill, 5 set state 0x100000 (next fade goes through master volume), 6 snd_xa_reset; emu: 6 is sent by func_800462C8 before every CD data read; O.BIN SD_HandleSys (low)
runs snd_xa_fade_tick while request bit 0x100 (voice fade) is set; O.BIN SD_HandleVBLXA (med)

while state has 0x400 or 0x4000: xa_fade_acc += xa_fade_rate, on carry past 0xFF xa_volume -= xa_fade_step; <= 0 calls snd_xa_fade_finish, else SsSetSerialVol(0,xa_volume,xa_volume); O.BIN SD_HandleXAFadeOut (med)

snd_xa_control(0x74) stop; then, when the paused bit is clear (always the case here, the stop just cleared it), promote the queued clip and start it when xa_clip_start != 0; O.BIN SD_FinishFadeOutXA (med)

HYPOTHESIS: the speaker index is the heroine index (h-cdio: 25 of 104 xa_clip_request_set calls pass the current girl) so this is a per-voice loudness correction; fact: xa_volume_full = 100, except speaker 6 -> 125, 7/9/11 -> 95, 10 -> 90, 12/13 -> 110, 15 -> 105; emu: speaker 15 gave 0x69 in the prologue; no O.BIN row

class 3: 0x300 starts a voice clip from the 4-word request of xa_clip_request_get (speaker, base sector, start word, end word), 0x1300 stop (then snd_xa_promote_next), 0x2300 pause and 0x4300 resume (snd_xa_control only, no promote; no sender); start/end sectors = index*(0x20, or 8 for speaker 15)+channel+base -/+ 0x10; queues behind a playing clip with a fast fade; emu: 0x300 at frame 3836; O.BIN SD_XACall (low)

queued clip becomes the current one: xa_clip_end = xa_next_end, xa_resume_pos = xa_clip_start = xa_next_start, filter bytes shift down (xa_params[4,6] = [5,7]), next fields and bytes 5,7 cleared, level meter outputs cleared, state 0x400/0x4000 and request 0x200/0x100 cleared (so it also cancels a running voice fade and the paused mark, and issues no CD stop); the class-0 commands 0x74, 0xE4 and 0xF4 call it right after snd_xa_control; O.BIN SD_XAParamUpdate (med)

snd_cd_audio_init (mute, CD mode 0xC8), xa_params[0,1] = file,channel from bytes [6],[4], request 0x200, cd_command(0xD, start sector, xa_params); emu: break shows a0 = clip start 0x16E5C and the dumped state; O.BIN SD_PlayXA (med)

selector 0x74 stop (mix off, cd_command 9, clear 0x400/0x4000/0x200/0x100); 0xE4 pause (start pending: state 0x4000 and cd_command 9; playing: remember position, state 0x400 -> 0x4000, snd_xa_fade_start(0xB4)); 0xF4 resume (only when 0x4000 is set: replay from xa_resume_pos or finish the chain). The game sends 0xE4/0xF4 only as class-0 commands, where snd_control_dispatch calls snd_xa_promote_next right after, which undoes 0x4000 and the fade request, so pause does not fade or stop a playing clip and 0xF4 never acts (spec 8.4); the class-3 forms 0x2300/0x4300 skip the promote but nothing sends them; O.BIN SD_StopXA (low)

if no voice fade runs: xa_fade_acc = 0 and request bit 0x100; rate/step are always (re)written: (0x100,10) for 0xB4 and any other id, (0x100,1) for 0xC4, (0x80,1) for 0xD4, so a later command changes a running fade (unlike the BGM fade); O.BIN SD_FadeXA (low)

per frame: request bit 2 and snd_bgm_bank_ready -> snd_bgm_start; while BGM plays with request bit 1 (fade): bgm_fade_acc += rate, on carry bgm_volume -= step; < 0 -> snd_bgm_fade_finish, else SsSeqSetVol (or SsSetMVol scaled by bgm_volume*0x7F/bgm_volume_full when state 0x100000 and no voice clip); O.BIN SD_HandleVBLSEQ (low)

fade end: with state 0x100000 and no voice clip SsUtAllKeyOff and master volume 0; snd_bgm_control(0x71); starts bgm_seq_id (promoted from bgm_next_seq_id) when it is not -1; O.BIN SD_FinishFadeOutSEQ (low)

class 2: 0x2NN play sequence NN (request bit 1 -> finish the fade now and chain; BGM playing -> store NN in bgm_next_seq_id and fast fade 0xB1; else start now), 0x12NN stop, 0x22NN pause, 0x42NN resume; emu: 0x200 after 0x23,0x24,0x2E; O.BIN SD_SEQCall (med)
bgm_seq_id selected: start at once when the BGM slot has no transfer pending, else request bit 2 (snd_bgm_update waits); O.BIN SD_PlaySeq (med)

except in TT and TACO modes and when bgm_slot is 2: snd_voices_kill; reverb depth from snd_seq_reverb_depth[set][seq] (0 in sound-test mode 0x21 when state 0x10000000); SsSeqOpen(address,bgm_slot) (-1 -> error 0x0104xxxx, snd_bgm_fade_finish); state 0x100, bgm_volume = VAB master volume - 0x19 (-0x18 more in mono), SsSeqSetVol, SsSeqPlay(seq,1,1); emu: state 0x00040110 at frame 1464; O.BIN SD_SeqGo (low)

selector 0x71 stop (volume 0, SsSeqStop, SsSeqClose, bgm_seq_id = bgm_next_seq_id, next = -1, state 0x100/0x1000 and request 1 cleared), 0xE1 pause (SsSeqPause, state 0x1000), 0xF1 resume (SsSeqReplay, state 0x100); O.BIN SD_StopSeq (low)

whole body only if no BGM fade runs (a running fade ignores new fade ids): bgm_fade_acc = 0, request bit 1; (rate,step) = (0x100,10) 0xB1, (0xC0,1) 0xC1, (0x80,1) 0xD1; emu: 0xD1 re-sent every frame 4854-4911 without restarting; O.BIN SD_FadeSeq (low)
class 5: key = (se_slot_a<<8)|((id&0xFF)>>4) program, note word ((id&0xF)*4+0x18)<<8; id bit 0x1000 stops (snd_se_stop) else snd_se_play; O.BIN SD_SECall (med)
class 6: same as snd_cmd_se_a with se_slot_b as the bank; O.BIN SD_OtherSECall (med)
class 7: same as snd_cmd_se_a with bgm_slot (the bank of the running BGM) as the bank; O.BIN SD_SECallInSEQ (med)
class 8: same as snd_cmd_se_a with bgm_aux_slot as the bank; O.BIN SD_OtherSECallInSEQ (med)
releases the same (bank, program, note) then clears state 0x100000, SsSetMVol(0x7F,0x7F) and keys it on at se_volume both channels (SpuVmSeKeyOn in the asm); O.BIN SD_PlaySE (low)
key off of the (bank, program, note) in its arguments (SpuVmSeKeyOff in the asm); O.BIN SD_StopSE (low)
appends a u16 to the 32-entry queue at D_80125CC2 and returns 0; returns -1 and drops the command when the count is already 0x20; O.BIN SD_AddEvt (med)
count = 0; called at the end of snd_command_pump and in snd_init; O.BIN SD_FlashEvent (med)
returns the oldest queued command (0 when empty, so command 0 cannot be queued usefully) and shifts the rest down; O.BIN SD_GetNextEvent (med)
command 3: snd_xa_control(0x74) stop, then clears xa_clip_start/end, next, resume position and filter bytes 4,5; no O.BIN row; callers NAME_ENT, func_80075320, func_8005A0B0

command 6: serial mix off, clears state 0x400/0x4000 and request 0x200/0x100, all XA bookkeeping words, the level meter outputs and bytes 4,5; emu: sent before every CD data read; O.BIN SD_KillXA (low)

unless TT mode with BGM playing: SpuVmFlush guard, SsUtAllKeyOff(0), reverb off, reverb mode 3, reverb on (silences every sound-effect voice); command 4 and 0x72/0x73/0x7F bit 2; O.BIN SD_KillSPU (low)

stop and close the sequence when BGM plays or is paused, SsUtAllKeyOff, SsVabClose for each open slot (highest first), SsEnd, SsQuit; callers func_80042A00, func_80046500 before snd_init; O.BIN SD_Reset (low)
